mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversation (work_id, requirement_id, initiator_id, receiver_id) VALUES (#{workId}, #{requirementId}, #{initiatorId}, #{receiverId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.work_id AS workId, c.requirement_id AS requirementId, c.initiator_id AS initiatorId, c.receiver_id AS receiverId, c.update_time AS updateTime, COALESCE(w.title, r.title) AS workTitle, r.title AS requirementTitle, i_prof.nickname AS initiatorName, r_prof.nickname AS receiverName, (SELECT content FROM message WHERE conversation_id = c.id ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE conversation_id = c.id AND sender_id != #{userId} AND is_read = 0) AS unreadCount FROM conversation c LEFT JOIN work w ON c.work_id = w.id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON c.requirement_id = r.id LEFT JOIN user_profile i_prof ON c.initiator_id = i_prof.account_id LEFT JOIN user_profile r_prof ON c.receiver_id = r_prof.account_id WHERE (c.initiator_id = #{userId} AND c.hidden_by_initiator = 0) OR (c.receiver_id = #{userId} AND c.hidden_by_receiver = 0) ORDER BY c.update_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation WHERE (initiator_id = #{userId} AND hidden_by_initiator = 0) OR (receiver_id = #{userId} AND hidden_by_receiver = 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND sender_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET hidden_by_initiator = 1 hidden_by_receiver = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
